headline: My Website Looks Great, So Why Can't AI Find Me?
articleBody: It's super common to have a fantastic website, one that looks amazing and is easy for people to navigate, but still feel invisible to AI. Here's the thing: your website is built for humans, and that's awesome. But AI models and answer engines like ChatGPT or Google AI Overviews read content very differently than people do. They're looking for specific structures and signals. If your site doesn't have these, AI struggles to understand what you offer or even find you in the first place, even if a human would have zero trouble. Think about it this way: AI thrives on highly organized, clear, and specifically formatted information. This means using question-based headings, providing direct answers right at the start of sections, and employing structured data that basically tags your content for AI. If your site mostly relies on long paragraphs or doesn't explicitly mark up important information, those AI systems are probably just skimming right past your valuable content. It’s not about changing how your site looks, but rather how its underlying information is organized for machine readability. Many local businesses try to tackle this themselves, but it can get pretty technical, especially with legacy website issues, so sometimes professional help is really crucial to make sure your site speaks AI's language effectively.
